blocks: Figure 2: This figure displays the results of the equality of proportions test for pro- and anti-gun bill
proposals. Years shaded in dark colors represent years in which the proposal of pro-gun bills is lower
than average and anti-gun bills is higher than average at a statistically significant p value that is less
than .002. The years shaded in faint colors represent years in which the proposal of pro-gun bills is
lower than average and anti-gun bills is higher than average at a statistically significant p value that
is less than .003. The years shaded in black and white represent years in which the proposals of pro-
and anti-gun bills do not differ significantly from the average level of proposals across all years. The
p-values are generated by a Bonferroni correction, which is described below.
